_comment: mc-developing-mcp server configuration. See README.md for full documentation.
_comment2: Set 'mode' to 'minimal', 'balanced', or 'performance'. Individual keys override the mode preset.

_modes.minimal: Low-RAM machines (<4 GB). Smaller caches, lower result limits.
_modes.balanced: Standard dev machine (4-8 GB). Default preset.
_modes.performance: High-end workstation (16 GB+). Maximum caches and result limits.

_env_overrides.MC_MCP_MODE: Set mode via env var: MC_MCP_MODE=performance

_advanced_keys.sources_cache_kib: SQLite page cache for sources DB (negative = KiB). Default: -131072 (128 MiB)
_advanced_keys.sources_mmap_bytes: mmap size for sources DB in bytes. Default: 536870912 (512 MiB)
_advanced_keys.docs_cache_kib: SQLite page cache for docs DB. Default: -65536 (64 MiB)
_advanced_keys.docs_mmap_bytes: mmap size for docs DB in bytes. Default: 268435456 (256 MiB)
_advanced_keys.cached_statements: sqlite3 module statement cache size. Default: 512
_advanced_keys.lru_find_class: LRU cache entries for find_class. Default: 4096
_advanced_keys.lru_class_detail: LRU cache entries for get_class_detail. Default: 2048
_advanced_keys.lru_source: LRU cache entries for read_source. Default: 8192
_advanced_keys.lru_hierarchy: LRU cache entries for get_hierarchy. Default: 2048

_remote_section: Remote mode — run mcp_server/http_server.py on the server device (has databases), and mcp_server/remote_proxy.py on the client device (no databases). Leave remote_url empty for local mode.
